title: ATR and Bollinger Bands: measuring volatility

inOneLine.simple: ATR and Bollinger Bands measure how much price has been moving. Neither tells you which way it will move next.
inOneLine.balanced: [[atr|ATR]] averages the true range of recent candles. [[bollinger-bands|Bollinger Bands]] put bands 2 standard deviations around a 20-period average. Both describe past volatility and are slow to react to sudden changes.

explain.simple: ATR answers: how far has price typically moved per candle lately? On EUR/USD H1, an ATR of 0.00120 means about 12 pips per candle. That helps you see if a stop is tiny compared with normal movement. Bollinger Bands draw a line above and below an average. When price has been jumpy, the bands spread out. When it has been calm, they squeeze together. Neither tool says up or down.
explain.balanced: True range = the largest of high − low, |high − previous close| and |low − previous close|, so it includes gaps. ATR 14 averages it, with smoothing in most apps. ATR is backward-looking: before news it may be low, and then one candle is several times larger. Bollinger (20, 2): middle = SMA 20, bands = middle ± 2 × the standard deviation of the last 20 closes. A touch of the upper band is not "too high". In strong trends price can ride a band for many candles. A squeeze shows recent calm, and the move that follows can go either way, or not come at all.

assumptions: Previous close 1.10000; this candle: high 1.10300, low 1.10050
steps: True range = the largest = 30 pips. It is bigger than the candle itself because price gapped up from the previous close.
If ATR 14 is 12 pips, a 5-pip stop is less than half a typical candle's movement and could be hit by ordinary noise. A wider stop needs a smaller position to keep the same money at risk.

assumptions: Middle line (SMA 20) = 1.10000; standard deviation of the last 20 closes = 0.00150
steps: Price closes at 1.10320, above the upper band. In a strong uptrend this can happen candle after candle. Selling only because price is outside the band would mean selling into that trend.

explainSimpler: ATR is how big the waves have been. Bollinger Bands draw a lane that widens with bigger waves. Neither tells you which way the next wave goes.
commonMistake: Treating a Bollinger Band touch as a reversal signal, or a squeeze as a sign of which way price will break. Another mistake is trusting ATR right before major news, when the next candle may be far bigger than recent ones.

quickCheck.prompt: Previous close 1.20000. Candle high 1.20100, low 1.19750. What is the true range?

options.explanation: Right: high − low = 35 pips, which is larger than 10 pips (high − previous close) and 25 pips (previous close − low).
No: 1 pip is 0.00010, so a gap of 0.00350 is 35 pips, not 3.5. True range is the largest of high − low (35), high − previous close (10) and previous close − low (25).
No: that is only previous close − low.

quickCheck.prompt: Bollinger Bands are squeezed very tight. What does that tell you?

options.text: Recent price movement has been small
options.explanation: Right: narrow bands only describe recent calm.

options.text: A breakout upward is due next
options.explanation: No: a squeeze says nothing about direction, and a big move may not come at all.

quickCheck.prompt: ATR 14 on EUR/USD H1 reads 0.00090. What does it mean?

options.text: Price has moved about 9 pips per candle recently, in either direction
options.explanation: Right: ATR measures size of movement, not direction.

options.text: Price will rise 9 pips next hour
options.explanation: No: ATR has no direction and does not forecast.

options.text: Price has moved about 90 pips per candle recently, in either direction
options.explanation: No: 0.00090 is 9 pips, not 90, because 1 pip is 0.00010.

doItNow.instructions: On your demo account, add a moving average, Bollinger Bands, RSI, MACD and ATR to a EUR/USD chart, check their settings, then remove them. Follow the task card.

homework: In Chart Lab, choose the News shock scenario, turn on Bollinger (20, 2) and show ATR 14 below the chart. Long-press to compare the ATR just before the shock with the range of the shock candle. Then choose the Strong uptrend scenario and find a stretch where price rode along the upper band. Finally, pick one indicator from this module and write two sentences: what it measures, and one market condition where it misleads.
